mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.company_name || '-고유공모계좌' AS companyName , '0' AS fundCd , '' AS fundNm FROM SZX0AA t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr LIKE #{corpGr} UNION ALL SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.company_name || '(' || MIN(ia.fund_nm) || ' 외 ' || TO_CHAR(COUNT(*) - 1) || ' 계좌)' , '1' , MIN(ia.fund_nm) || ' 외 ' || TO_CHAR(COUNT(*) - 1) || ' 계좌' FROM SZX0AA t1 , SZM0IA ia , UZM0UH uh WHERE t1.corp_gr LIKE #{corpGr} AND t1.corp_gr = '2202' AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE('2999-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND uh.fund_cd = ia.fund_cd AND uh.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.type_gb NOT IN ('0','5','6') GROUP BY t1.corp_gr, t1.company_name UNION ALL SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.company_name || '(' || MIN(ia.fund_nm) || ' 외 ' || TO_CHAR(COUNT(*) - 1) || ' 개인계좌)' , '1' , MIN(ia.fund_nm) || ' 외 ' || TO_CHAR(COUNT(*) - 1) || ' 개인계좌' FROM SZX0AA t1 , SZM0IA ia , UZM0UH uh WHERE t1.corp_gr LIKE #{corpGr} AND t1.corp_gr != '2202' AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE('2999-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND uh.fund_cd = ia.fund_cd AND uh.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.type_gb = '1' GROUP BY t1.corp_gr, t1.company_name UNION ALL SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.company_name || '(' || MIN(ia.fund_nm) || ' 외 ' || TO_CHAR(COUNT(*) - 1) || ' 법인계좌)' , '2' , MIN(ia.fund_nm) || ' 외 ' || TO_CHAR(COUNT(*) - 1) || ' 법인계좌' FROM SZX0AA t1 , SZM0IA ia , UZM0UH uh WHERE t1.corp_gr LIKE #{corpGr} AND t1.corp_gr != '2202' AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE('2999-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND uh.fund_cd = ia.fund_cd AND uh.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.type_gb = '2' GROUP BY t1.corp_gr, t1.company_name UNION ALL SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.company_name || '(' || ia.fund_nm || ')-개인별공모참여' , ia.fund_cd , ia.fund_nm FROM SZX0AA t1 , SZM0IA ia , UZM0UH uh WHERE t1.corp_gr LIKE #{corpGr} AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE('2999-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND uh.fund_cd = ia.fund_cd AND uh.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.type_gb = '5' UNION ALL SELECT t1.corp_gr , t1.company_name || '(' || ia.fund_nm || ')-법인별공모참여' , ia.fund_cd , ia.fund_nm FROM SZX0AA t1 , SZM0IA ia , UZM0UH uh WHERE t1.corp_gr LIKE #{corpGr} AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND NVL(ia.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE('2999-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND uh.fund_cd = ia.fund_cd AND uh.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.type_gb = '6' ORDER BY 1 ASC, 3 ASC
